name: Calendar
summary: A month of days to choose one day or a range, that zooms out the way the Windows calendar does: press the title to see the year's months, again for the decade's years, again for the century's decades; choosing one zooms back in. Previous and next page by the view's period; Today comes back. Built for DatePicker and DateRangePicker, and usable on its own on a page. Not for a date someone knows by heart and types faster (a birth date: a TextField or three NumberFields), or for times.
a11y: A `table role="grid"` per view (WAI-ARIA APG date picker): one cell in the tab order (roving), each named by its full date, `aria-selected` on the choice, `aria-current="date"` on today, `aria-disabled` outside min and max or when unavailable. The title is a button that zooms out and announces the new period politely. Week numbers are row headers. The zoom is a Morph: the levels scale and cross-fade (only fade with reduced motion); a page turned by keys swaps at once.

keys.action: a day (or a month, year, decade); Up and Down a week (or a row)
the start / end of the week (or row)
the previous / next month (or year, decade, century); with Shift, a year
chooses the day, or zooms into the month, year or decade

props.name: label
props.description: Names the calendar for assistive technology: "Start date", "Delivery date".

props.name: mode
props.description: `single` (default): one day. `range`: a first and a last day, with the days between shown as one band.

props.name: value
props.description: With `single`: the chosen day, `yyyy-mm-dd`, or null.

props.name: range
props.description: With `range`: the first and last day, `yyyy-mm-dd`; the last is null while only the first is chosen.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: With `range`: the first day, then the last, as they are chosen. A day before the first starts again from it.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest and latest days that can be chosen, `yyyy-mm-dd`.

props.name: isUnavailable
props.description: Days that can't be chosen (fully booked, weekends): they show struck through, stay reachable by keys and can't be chosen.

props.name: weekNumbers
props.description: Shows the ISO week number before each week.

props.name: months
props.description: Two months side by side, for choosing a range across a month's end.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language for names and the first day of the week; the browser's by default.

props.name: firstDay
props.description: 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday; from the locale by default.

props.name: initialMonth
props.description: The month shown first, `yyyy-mm` or any day in it; the chosen day's month, or today's, by default.
